newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela comptroller to launch investigation.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela comptroller to launch investigation.

text.p: Venezuelan Comptroller General Eduardo Roche Lander on Tuesday said he launched an investigation of top government officials over alleged irregularities in government spending.

Roche Lander said he would look into accusations made by opposition legislator Carmelo Lauria, president of the Chamber of Deputies Finance Committee, that ministers had changed their spending allocations after the 1997 budget had been approved.
The comptroller said officials made the spending changes without backing them up with sufficient revenue.
Roche Lander, who has frequently highlighted corruption in President Rafael Caldera's government, said such irregularities should also be viewed as corrupt.
